{{Quote|I met this Neimoidian in a drinkin' hole on Tatooine. Claimed t'be related to Medd Valii. I looked up this Valii. Seems he was pretty big back in the day. Made money. Lotsa money. Well, this relation got to talking, see, said Valii hid his money in this city on Cato Neimoidia. Look at it. Called Tarko-se, now, Empire-run, but not always. Seemed these Neimodians used this planet to stash their wealth. Called it a 'purse world'. Most of 'em built vaults deep underground, ransacked now, of course, but some were a bit cleverer about it|Adah Meborman|<ref name="Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PS3]]/[[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] "[[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]]" databank entry}}</ref>}}
'''Adah Meborman''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who spoke with an accent.<ref name="Force Unleashed II" /> At somepoint by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' occurred in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], per the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]], thus Adah Meborman must have met the [[Unidentified Neimoidian (drinking hole)|Neimoidian]] by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. The Imperial investigation into Meborman must have occurred by the same year and after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] formed, which the ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19]].</ref> Meborman meet a [[Unidentified Neimoidian (drinking hole)|Neimoidian]] at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]<ref name="Force Unleashed II" /> on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While talking with Meborman, the [[Neimoidian]] claimed to be related to [[Medd Valii]], an individual who had accrued a large amount of [[Currency/Legends|money]] during his lifetime. The Neimoidian went on to explain to the smuggler that Valii had hid his money in the form of pure [[Gold/Legends|gold]] within the three mile arch of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]] on the planet [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II" /> 

Sometime later, between [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] investigated Meborman while the smuggler was in Tarko-se looking for a way to steal Valii's rumored wealth. During the investigation, the Empire transcribed Meborman while they were recounting their meeting with the Neimoidian and where they believed Medd Valii had stashed his wealth.<ref name="Force Unleashed II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adah Meborman was mentioned in "Tarko-se" databank entry in the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="Force Unleashed II" />
